one_liner: Open-source CRM with workspace-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, API keys, OAuth, and a vendor-hosted MCP server. Self-hosting is documented. Cloud plan and trial terms are not confirmed by the fetched pages.
auth_notes: API keys are Bearer tokens created in Settings → Developers → API. The API page points to OAuth for external apps acting on behalf of users. The MCP page describes OAuth with discovery and dynamic client registration (RFC 7591). The fetched pages do not describe OAuth for the REST API in detail. Composio lists only API_KEY, so confidence is medium.
access_notes: The fetched pages do not include the pricing page, so cloud trial and plan terms cannot be verified from them. Self-hosting is documented as a first-class path, and API keys work against self-hosted base URLs. The access label is a low-confidence best guess. The earlier claims about pricing, the free trial and plan prices could not be checked against the pages.
blocker_notes: Cloud plan or trial requirements are unverified from the fetched pages. Each workspace has its own schema, so setup is per customer. Self-hosting is a documented alternative.
